##### Project general facts

One River Point by Ellington Properties is a striking architectural landmark set along the Dubai Canal, with views extending towards the iconic Burj Khalifa. The tower is defined by its sculptural form and contemporary design language, where clean lines and refined geometry create a bold yet elegant presence. Thoughtfully integrated into its urban surroundings, the building reflects a seamless balance between innovation, functionality, and visual sophistication, offering a distinctive lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most desirable waterfront settings.

The development features a curated collection of amenities designed to support a wellness-focused and elevated lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a range of leisure and fitness spaces, all unified within a cohesive architectural concept that emphasizes openness and flow. From relaxation zones to social and activity areas, every element is designed to enhance everyday living while creating a sense of exclusivity and community within a visually striking environment.

Interiors at One River Point are finished with high-end materials and contemporary detailing, combining warm tones with refined textures to create a calm and sophisticated atmosphere. Equipped kitchens are seamlessly integrated, with select larger residences featuring enhanced fittings such as integrated sinks and advanced extraction systems. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalize their spaces while benefiting from a premium foundation of design, craftsmanship, and modern comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay, Dubai, can be confusing due to its name. However, it’s not just office spaces and buildings. There are hotel towers, amazing restaurants and wonderful residential properties here as well. It is known to be a very stylish and up-to-date in the latest trends and gadgets kind of community. The life here is face-paced.

Business Bay is on the south side of Downtown Dubai. This area usually hosts plenty of events to keep things lively. There are music festivals, Mother’s Day celebrations, New Year’s celebrations and many others as well. The lifestyle that Business Bay offers has many advantages.

Famous and international schools, medicals, supermarkets, banks and finance centers are a few minutes from your space. The place simply elevates your life standard and way of living with easy and intuitive options in the proximity. Come and seek refuge in this wonderful place full of potential elements of pleasures, success and fun.
